about: The Workbench icons of the Abe drawer: python3 AMICRADLE/scripts/port_icons.py amiga/icons/icons.json --out amiga/icons (DalsinAI/amicradle). The art is Abe himself (tom4.bmp in upstream's images.tar, GPL 2 or later), as Debian makes its icon. Abe-drawer.info is the drawer's own icon, Abe.info beside the program. ReadMe.info is also copied for upstream's README and the licence.
